title: Unit Event — Over Rad Squad!! — Episode6 RAD BLAST

meta.Event Outline: The time to surpass RAD WEEKEND has come at last. Kohane is nervous about the task ahead, but musters up her resolve as she looks back on everything she's overcome to get this far. Will Vivid BAD SQUAD finally do it?!

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: The advance tickets sold out the second they went on sale. The ones that were being sold today are supposedly gone too now, but I guess these people are desperate enough to try their luck.

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
I mean, I get how they feel.
If I weren't able to get a ticket, then I'd at least try to listen from outside.

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
Yeah...
And there's a huge crowd gathered around the entrance to COL already.

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: I can't wait to see how this event turns out...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (There's plenty of people, and they're all excited... As expected... No, this exceeds my expectations.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Hey, you made it just in time...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
At the cost of some work.
You really need to give me a year in advance if you're going to invite me to something like this.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Yeah, I know the life of a superstar's a busy one.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I've been getting offers left, right and center, you know. My friends asked what was wrong with me.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Saying I must be crazy to put an event with a name as uninventive as “RAD BLAST” above those opportunities.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Good name, right?
They came up with it.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: It's supposed to symbolize them blasting this neighborhood's legend out of the way and propelling themselves towards the world beyond that.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
They've got guts.
We'll see if they deliver the goods.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Actually, what are you doing out here?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
You brought them this far, didn't you?
I thought the head coach would be giving his team a big pep talk backstage before sending them out.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
This isn't my event.
It's theirs. The next generation's.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Which means this old man needs to take a step back.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (There is one thing that I still need to say.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Also, nothing I could say would be as effective as what you did. That's been their biggest source of motivation.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You made them taste bitter defeat that night.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
I wasn't trying to motivate them.
I was just putting them in their place.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That being said... They've come this far, so I need to how strong they are.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This atmosphere... The event hasn't even started yet, but everything feels completely different from our usual events.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (People wanting to witness the moment we surpass RAD WEEKEND. People wanting us to make Nagi's wish come true.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Even from up here, I can feel this powerful mix of emotions.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I was looking up towards the stage that time, but now I get to see things from Aunt Nagi's perspective.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Not even the most prestigious contest I ever entered into made me feel this nervous.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, you guys. Wanna form a huddle?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it'll be a good way to psych ourselves up before we go out there.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I agree.
So, let's pump ourselves up one last time!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
...?
Start us off? What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I've been betting everything I have on this day!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I hated how I could never get serious and fully commit to anything I was doing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Then, RAD WEEKEND came along.
I'd found something I could devote my life to.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Once we surpass it, I can finally be proud of myself.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Everything I've done has been for this day...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, no matter what, we're going to surpass that night...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: After coming to this neighborhood, I found a partner, met new friends and was introduced to a new genre of music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The time we've spent together has allowed me to accept myself for who I am. I was able to come to terms with my past and bring it into the present.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wouldn't have been able to overcome the obstacles that I faced along the way without all of you. I was able to keep moving forward as a result.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was able to make it this far.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I want to see the impact the song I wrote has on this neighborhood. I want to see how far I can go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which is why I'm going to give this day absolutely everything I have.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
...!
I—I want to say goodbye to my weak, pathetic self!!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I wanna stop being someone that snickers at others and puts them down for having a dream. I wanna say goodbye to that guy!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I'm gonna give myself validation by surpassing the greatest event I ever saw!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I... For once, I'm going to sing for the sake of believing in myself.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I don't care who ridicules me. I'm going to keep going after my dream. Somewhere along the way, I'd forgotten about that and started letting others tell me what to do.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I don't care if anyone says that I can't win or what I'm doing is impossible. I'm going to keep trying. I'm going to surpass RAD WEEKEND! And I'm going to believe in myself!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (These are the things that they never want to give up on...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I couldn't find the right words for it that time... That feeling...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I admired RAD WEEKEND.
I admired Aunt Nagi so much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I always dreamt of someday catching up to her, then running alongside her and eventually overtaking her.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can't sing alongside her now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can carry her dream forward.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can go see the world beyond it. Go where she couldn't.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Once I surpass RAD WEEKEND. I'm sure of it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I'm going to surpass it no matter what!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to see what lies beyond RAD WEEKEND after surpassing it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Because I'm sure that I'll get to experience that sensation again. The excitement I felt when I heard An sing for the very first time. Actually, no...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know there's something out there that's going to excite me even more!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I want to go to that place!
I don't care if anyone tries to stop me! I'm going!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's make this night the best one of our lives!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's go out there and put on a performance like they've never seen before!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Let's surpass RAD WEEKEND!
And become a new legend!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Sounds like you're all pumped up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
...! Dad?!
I thought you were in the audience...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: There's one last thing I need to tell your partner.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Kohane.
As discussed, you'll be doing your thing during the final song.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
...and that's it.
That's all you have to do.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Do you think you'll be able to?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
The crowd's starting to get antsy.
I'm not sure they can wait much longer.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I doubt we will, but we need to make sure that we don't get caught up in the heat of the moment.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Right!
Let's go out there and blow the roof off this place!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright, you two are kicking things off for us, Azusawa, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Give them everything you've both got.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, we will!
Let's do this, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (The first act's job is to set the stage for the entire event. So... Failure is not an option.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Just a second ago, the thought of not succeeding almost overwhelmed my mind...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What the others said helped me realize what is it that I want to do.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I have An here next to me!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(...!
There's so much excitement in the air!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(It's like we're already at the finale.
And it's so hot that I can't see the audience very well.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But we need to raise the temperature...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We need to get them even more excited!!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Alright, they're off to a good start!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The battle they had the other day taught them the importance of pushing each other to get better.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Which means they now know how to stoke an ember into a blaze!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
I'm getting goosebumps.
Their singing's amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This is so exciting, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Nice work.
You really got the ball rolling.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Can you hear what they're saying in the audience?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Whoa...!!
And that was just the first song...!!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
How can things still get better?!
Wh-Where is this going...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We gotta take this energy and keep knocking their socks off!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Shinonome, Aoyagi!
You two are up next!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are you smirking at, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I could be asking you the same thing, Akito.
Aren't you feeling nervous at all?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I left any nerves behind long ago. All I care about now is...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Surpassing that night. End of story.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Let's go out there and make our dream a reality, Akito.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Good, they kicked things up a gear...!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Man...
The way they hold those long notes is incredible...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Akito! Toya! You're both doing great!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We let those two take the first spot...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But they aren't the only partners who get to push each other higher!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We kept pushing each other all this time to get better and make sure of one thing.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That we become the partners that we each deserve!!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, my heart's pounding like crazy...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That was awesome, you two!
They're bouncing off the walls now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Make them go even crazier for us!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
I will!
This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, and I'm not about to mess it up!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I ran away, but you guys were willing to give me another chance to chase after this dream.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: So, what kind of man would that make me if I didn't seize that chance?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Right.
So, go show them what you've got!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yo! Next up is the one and only Kotaro Mita! Lemme hear your voices!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
(Some are gonna get hyped for me...
But some won't. They're gonna think that I'm a nobody, and it's gonna kill the vibe...)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Who would've guessed in a million years that I'd be up here trying to surpass RAD WEEKEND?!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Watch closely, you guys! You guys aren't gonna know what hit you!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: (They did everything they possibly could to create this atmosphere! And I'm not about to ruin their hard work!)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I'm the lone-wolf rapper who's spent all his time singing on Vivid Street! Getting you guys going is a piece of cake!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
I still can't hear you!
Louder, you guys! Louder!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Seriously, when did he get so—

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Who cares...?!
You're doing awesome, Kotaro!!!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: They sound amazing! I'm being shaken to the core...!!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: (Even these guys found a way to get good.)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: They all feel the same way...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
(Hm...? That kid's in a wheelchair...
Maneuvering around in this crowd can't be easy...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, kid, you okay? You look like you're not feeling well...

I'm okay, thank you.
This pain's manageable...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Nice...!
EVER's in good form too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: All that's left is for us to push the door fully open.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Stop!
You're not allowed back there!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
...?
What's going on? I thought I heard some shouting coming from over there...

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Hello! I said you can't go in—
Wait, don't I know you from somewhere?

I'm sorry.
I know I'm asking the impossible.
But please let me go in. I beg you.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Sorry, everyone.
I know I couldn't have picked a worse time to come back.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Soma made it and sent it over to me.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: He said, “Surpass that night using this.”

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: He also sent me this note with it.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: “I was so moved by the song Aoyagi wrote. If it genuinely moves you in the same way, then I want you to listen to this all the way to the end.”

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
I couldn't listen to it at first...
It didn't feel right of me to since I couldn't carry his dream anymore...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But I eventually decided that I had to at least listen to it. When I did, I finally realized...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: That I... I want to keep carrying Soma's dream.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
I don't care if I can or should.
That's what I want to do.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: That's what sits at the core of my ego. I don't care how selfish I'm being.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I want to carry his dream.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I know this sounds ridiculous after running away and returning at the worst possible time...!!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
But please...!
Let me sing this song...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You haven't lost your step or anything, right...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
I'm ready.
I ran from you guys, but I never gave up on my singing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You know how to get them fired up even more, right?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya's Voice
rows.Line: Louder! I know you guys can do better than that!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
EVER's almost finished.
Get ready. We'll go put on that track.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: And thank you as well, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Soma said in his message how your song made the one he wrote possible.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, my song was just meant to be a reflection of who we are as a team.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I think Soma was able to write his song because of how he felt about you.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Then, I'll sing with those feelings in mind.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I'm going to show them what Soma and I are all about.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
EVER was off the hook...!
No other team can sing the way they do!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah! And I'm getting drenched in sweat! It's so hot in here!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: More importantly, Vivid BAD SQUAD's next, right?! What do you think they're gonna sing?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
It's Arata!
Wait, was he scheduled to perform?!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
(He is here...
But he must've only just managed to stand recently.)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I'm right there with you, Arata!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: By your side... With my song...!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Whoa...
This feels like a dream...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: I think we're witnessing history here...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Way to go, Arata...
He just sent them flying even higher.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, he did...
Or rather, they did. Together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Still, I can't believe he made us wait until the last second.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The energy is the same as it was at RAD WEEKEND. I can feel it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But that means we still haven't surpassed it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Whether or not we do now depends entirely on us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Sorry, everyone...
I'm going to get a quick drink of water.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I'll try to stay focused until we go on too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (No matter what, we're going to do it!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And I'm going to complete that task...!!)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Kohane.
As discussed, you'll be doing your thing during the final song.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You need to throw everything you're feeling in that moment into the song.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: That's your second task... Your final one.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (If I can't do that, then we'll...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(No, now's not the time...!
I have to go...! I have to go out there and—)
